parts.label: a
parts.technique: E(X) of discrete random variable

parts.technique: Histogram width/height from frequency density
parts.reason: S2.1 explicitly covers histograms where area represents frequency.

parts.label: c

parts.label: e

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Mean of discrete data set (sample mean)

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Binomial probability calculation

parts.label: c

parts.label: d

parts.label: e

parts.reason: S4.3 explicitly covers selecting an appropriate probability distribution with reasoning.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Comparing summary statistics (mean, standard deviation) between two data sets
parts.reason: S2.3 covers interpretation of measures of central tendency and variation such as mean and standard deviation.

parts.label: (b)(i)-(ii)
parts.technique: Identifying and explaining an outlier on a scatter diagram
parts.reason: S2.4 explicitly covers recognising and interpreting possible outliers in statistical diagrams including scatter diagrams (S2.2 guidance).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Recalculating mean after removing a data point
parts.reason: S2.3 covers calculation of mean from summary statistics, no exclusion applies to simple mean recalculation.

parts.label: (d)(i)-(ii)
parts.technique: Calculating Sxy for use in PMCC/regression formulae
parts.reason: This computes the summary statistic Sxy purely as a step toward the PMCC and regression line formulae, both of which are explicitly excluded (S2.2 regression lines excluded; PMCC formula from summary statistics excluded).

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Calculating PMCC from summary statistics using the formula
parts.reason: Explicit exclusion: 'using the PMCC formula from summary statistics... are OUT'; also S5.1 states use of the formula is not required.

parts.label: f
parts.technique: Calculating the regression line equation from summary statistics
parts.reason: S2.2 explicit exclusion: 'calculations involving regression lines are excluded'.

parts.label: g
parts.technique: Interpreting increase in PMCC value to justify data decision
parts.reason: Depends on the PMCC value calculated in part (e), which is out-of-spec (formula-based calculation); rule states a part relying on an out-of-spec answer is OUT.

parts.label: h
parts.technique: Using regression line equation to estimate a value
parts.reason: Depends directly on the regression line equation found in out-of-spec part (f); calculations involving regression lines are explicitly excluded.
